value.rationale: The motivating Schur spectral analysis explicitly requires an SPD approximate Schur block. This theorem quantifies the exact positive probability of violating that premise with an SPD input family, a sharp worst family-wide risk and infinite mean amplification even when the implementation adds any fixed positive scalar ridge. These are operationally meaningful reliability boundaries, not merely a cheap counterexample or generic already-known instability.
